chapter_title_en: Departure of Avtandil in Quest of the Knight
chapter_expert_explanation_en: Avtandil wanders across the world for two years and nine months seeking news of the stranger knight. Just as his three-year term is nearly spent, he meets three Khatavian brothers in the wilderness whose youngest brother was struck down with a whip by the Knight in the Panther's Skin, and follows their directions to Tariel's cliffside cave.

stanzas.english_translation: Then he said, "Patience is better," and communed thus with himself: "Let me not die a day too soon, cast not down my heart; without God I can do nothing, my tears flow in vain. Thou wilt go back; T’hinat’hin, who brightens the sunny day, will meet thee; she will ask thee for tidings of that sun; what does groaning avail?" Thus thinking, he forthwith sets out for the reedy, watery edge of the wood.
